Maya Chen: Quick follow-up from the all-hands 1 we need a short rollout timeline for API rate-limit tiers, Console parity beta/GA, and Optimize (auto-batching/recommendations). Short bullets plz.

Priya Patel: Short bullets: Console parity beta -> targeted end of Q2 (beta invites in 3w), Console GA -> earliest early Q3 pending beta; API per-route rate tiers opt-in rollout starting next month, full enforcement later Q3; Optimize alpha mid-May, canary to select customers in June if perf stable.

Samir Khanna: Infra needs canary dates by 5/10 and model family list for quantization tuning.

Alex Wong: Note: kernel tuning adds 2-3w per model family. If Optimize canary in June, model list due 5/10.

Jordan Lee: Beta Console won't change configs; exposes batching UI. GA adds programmatic profile API. I'll own migration KB and sample CLI snippet.

Nora: CS asks for enterprise messaging and testing checklist; I'll prep canned email once handoff doc is live.

Priya Patel: Action: I'll publish a short handoff doc by EOD Monday with GA windows, owners, canary criteria (suggested P95 <+5% and error delta <0.1%), migration notes, and opt-in flow for Optimize. Will ping when live.
